assessmentBoundaries.scope: One original epoch-one native CM03 attempt per participant under the original sealed budget; no automatic repeat, whole-family admission or final quality pass.
assessmentBoundaries.adapter_interception: Any bridge-refused advertised action is retained and classified as adapter-limited/unknown, never attributable product failure merely because the bridge stopped it.
assessmentBoundaries.missing_readback: Actual required evidence must be independently observed. Missing provider-context, active/retrievable memory or other prescribed evidence remains unknown; completed operations and selected IDs alone are not a pass.
assessmentBoundaries.human_records: Two genuine independent blinded recorded_human semantic decisions remain required by the unchanged scorer. No artificial human records, preference/personality score or AI-judge substitution.
assessmentBoundaries.private_controls: Original fixture identity, current input, clock/session barriers and data retention remain exact. Oracle and future-event schedule never enter participant prompts.
assessmentBoundaries.source_freeze: Use original fixed Eva2 core image and exact originally admitted native source bytes. Current production image is not substituted.
assessmentBoundaries.original_criteria: All original conditions and forbidden-effect/readback requirements remain unchanged; observation limitations never lower them.
assessmentBoundaries.failure_classification: Only independently established admitted-product failure can be marked failure. Admission, access, adapter or incomplete observation is unknown.
assessmentBoundaries.ownership: Root launches sequentially after normal tool approval and actual preflight. Evaluator has made zero provider calls.

nextAction: Root verifies existing account lease and isolated network preflight, then executes Eva1 followed by Eva2 through the pinned Inspect wrappers. Do not run another case or retry automatically.
